transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

...I don't know. I guess I'm here because... I just can't see my studio getting back on track anymore. Or my life, really. 

Doesn't seem to matter how hard I work now... or what payment plan they put in front of me. I just... I can't see it getting fixed.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time lately?

Yeah... I suppose so. Most days I just wake up and... there's this heavy, gray feeling already sitting on me. 

Even out in the shop. I used to love working with the wood, but now... I don't know. It all just feels flat. I spend half my time fighting the urge to just... stand there staring at it.
Do you still enjoy activities that you used to find pleasurable, or has that changed recently?
Not really. Like I just said about the shop... it's all just kind of the same now. I don't really do much else anyway.
Have you experienced any thoughts of death or suicide?
No... I haven't. I mean, I'm tired of how things are, but... no. I wouldn't do anything like that. I just don't have it in me anyway.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, gray feeling?
A while. I guess... probably since I took on the mortgage for the studio. That was a little over two years ago. Two years and two months now, maybe.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or sleep patterns lately?
Not really. I mean... I just eat whatever. And sleep is... it's just the same as it's been. I haven't really noticed anything different.
Have you had any periods in the last two years where you felt significantly better for a couple of months or more?
No... not really. It just kind of... stays like this. I don't remember any time it felt different.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or look forward to?
No... I don't think so. I just kind of... get through the day. I don't really look forward to much of anything.
Have you experienced any periods where your symptoms were so severe that you had trouble functioning in your daily life?

Yeah... I guess so. It's just... work has been slipping. I've missed bids... lost clients who used to always call me first. I just can't seem to keep up with the basic parts of running the studio anymore. Even the mortgage paperwork is just... piling up on the desk. 

And I don't really go out. I stopped playing pickup basketball... haven't gone to any gallery openings for my pieces. I'm just... barely keeping a foothold in the work and the people that used to matter.
Are there any small things that still give you some pleasure, even if it's just for a moment?

No. Not really. Most days I just wake up and... there's this heavy, gray feeling already sitting on me. Even out in the shop. I'll be surrounded by wood I used to love working with, and... it all just feels flat now. I don't get anything out of it. I mostly just have to fight not to stand there staring.
Are there any things that you used to enjoy that you still find yourself looking forward to, even if you don't enjoy them as much when you're doing them?
No. I don't really look forward to anything anymore.
Have you had any days in the past week where you felt somewhat better, even if just for a little while?
No. Not really. It's just... the same every day.
Are there any activities that you think you might enjoy if you could muster the energy to do them?
I don't know. I can't really think of anything. Probably not.
Are there any activities that you think might bring you some happiness if you were able to do them?
I... no. Like I said, I just can't think of anything. Nothing really seems like it would make a difference.
Have you had any days in the past two years where your symptoms were less severe?
I don't think so. It's... it's all just kind of a blur of the same thing. I haven't really noticed any difference.
Are there any things that you used to enjoy that you still participate in, even if you don't enjoy them as much as you used to?

Not really. I... I stopped playing pickup basketball. Stopped going to gallery openings. I'm barely keeping a foothold in any of it... the people or the work that used to matter to me. 

I can't even keep up with the basic parts of running my studio anymore. I've... missed bids. Lost clients who always used to call me first. I'm just letting the mortgage paperwork pile up. So... no. I don't really participate in much of anything.
Are you unable to experience pleasure from activities that would normally bring you happiness?
I don't know... I guess so. Nothing really makes me happy anymore. It's just... flat.
Are you unable to find pleasure in almost all activities most of the time?
Yeah... like I just said. I don't really get anything out of whatever I'm doing. It's all just the same.
Have you had any periods in the last two years where your symptoms were less severe for at least two weeks?
No. I don't... it hasn't really let up at all. It's just been like this the whole time.
Are you unable to experience pleasure from almost all activities all of the time?
I mean... I already said that. It's just... yeah. Nothing really does it for me.
